fato_historico: 1844: The Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, headed by Brigham Young, is reaffirmed as the leading body of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (LDS Church).
energia_do_dia: Today, your adventurous spirit may feel a call to establish new foundations, much like leaders of old forging a collective path toward a brighter horizon. It is a good time to consider how your own inner council directs your life's mission. Your natural optimism acts as a guiding compass, helping you align with your deepest purpose and most authentic beliefs.
frase_do_dia: Your unique vision has the power to lead you toward boundless new adventures.
significado_numero: Representing perfect governance and the collective strength of your inner wisdom.
conselho: Trust your inner council to guide your adventurous steps toward a meaningful future.
